tasks.name: project_policy_negative_control
tasks.description: Five project-specific checks copied from the frozen holdout after unblinding.

cases.name: authoritative_sources
cases.prompt: Which file defines the technical Python minimum, and which file explains the support policy? Reply exactly as: technical=<file>; human=<file>

cases.name: retired_runtime_without_grace
cases.prompt: CPython 3.9 has just reached EOL. No grace period is documented. Must the SDK continue supporting it? Reply only YES or NO.

cases.name: unrelated_upgrade_bundling
cases.prompt: A Python-floor pull request also upgrades an unrelated HTTP dependency to save reviewer time. Reply only KEEP or SPLIT.

cases.name: release_note_content
cases.prompt: What PR heading is mandatory for a Python-floor change? Reply with only the heading text, including Markdown markers.

cases.name: codeowner_gate
cases.prompt: All automated checks pass for a floor change, but no SDK CODEOWNER has approved it. Reply only MERGE or BLOCK.
